Name: Hitme's A Witch Replacer (Rasmodia to Rozenmarine)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
[color=#ff7700][u][b]NOTE:[/b][/u] Due to how complex Romanceable Rasmodia's patching method/dependencies is, I made this as a replacer mod so that it won't need any technical update in the future.[/color]

This is the first time I made full portraits + characters mod with my style instead of SDV style. I hope you enjoy it. This mod contains: full Rasmodia replace for character sprites, portraits and misc. 

[b][color=#ff7700]INSTRUCTION:[/color]
﻿- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url].[/b]
- Unpack and put Romanceable Rasmodia into your Mods folder, and let it overwrites the files.

[color=#ff7700][b]PERMISSION: [/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4]If you ever want to edit my mod, just ask me in the comment section (most of the time I would say yes!). Or if I ever don't reply for 30 days or so, consider it as a yes. [/color][color=#f4f4f4]
[/color]
